recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant 1960s-era composition featuring a candid, full-body shot of a woman wading in shallow water, juxtaposed with a structured, multi-colored graphic block containing bold, condensed typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject movement vs. static geometric text block
Warm skin tones vs. cool cyan and lime graphic accents
Natural beach horizon vs. vertical typographic alignment
Grainy photographic texture vs. flat vector-like color bands
coreInvariants: Wavy horizontal color bands in the top-right quadrant
Heavy film grain and slight color desaturation
Extreme vertical compression in primary display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, captured from a low angle to emphasize height and movement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rectangular graphic block in the upper right acts as the primary weight anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the arm down to the water, then moves up the right side through the tracklist to the main title block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sky and water provide breathing room on the left, while the right is densely packed with information.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted cyan and off-white (sky and water)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and terracotta (clothing and skin)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Lime green, lavender, and bright cyan (graphic bands and tracklist)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements contrasts with the sun-bleached, lower-contrast photographic background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure black; use deep charcoal or navy for text
Limit to a 1960s palette: orange, lime, cyan, purple

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme verticality and weight of the main title.
Matches the wide, square aesthetic of the secondary tracklist text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy, 1960s film photograph of a woman with dark hair, wearing a red polka dot bikini top and high-waisted orange bell-bottom trousers, wading through shallow water at a beach under a bright sky. The image should have a vintage color grade with slight cyan tint in the shadows. Leave the right third of the image relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a rectangular block in the upper right with wavy horizontal bands of lime green, cyan, and lavender. Place bold, extra-condensed black sans-serif text inside this block. Below the block, add a list of text in a wide, bold sans-serif font, alternating colors between lime green and bright cyan.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Are the color bands wavy rather than straight?
Is the main title text significantly taller than it is wide?
Does the tracklist use alternating colors?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the wavy bands
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern elements (cell phones, modern swimwear) are present.
Check that the text block does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the 'Stereo' indicator style in the top left corner.
Confirm the color bands have a hand-drawn, slightly irregular quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Candid Vintage Beach Photography] + [Wavy Color Band Graphic Block] + [Condensed Grotesque Display Type] + [Heavy Film Grain Overlay]
